notes:
Written by am-06-x from two pages (budget 2-5). Not settled:
(1) The dossier ends in August 1791 although the page gives the colony's span as 1659 to 1803: Cliopatria's Haiti row (1792-1802, group am-08) covers exactly the same western third of Hispaniola, so the revolutionary years are left to haiti. If the reviewers prefer one state, extend this dossier to 1803/1804 and absorb haiti's 1792-1802 shapes. The page does not list rebel-held areas in 1791-1793 and dates the British occupation (1793-1798) only by name.
(2) The page gives no frontier before 1777 and no named boundary places for 1777 ('upper Artibonite Valley' only); the Centre department is the researcher's reading. The Basel (22 July 1795) cession of Spanish Santo Domingo and Louverture's invasion of it (January 1801) concern Spanish Hispaniola, which has no dossier (a Captaincy General of Santo Domingo, 1535 onwards, is the gap-filler's).
(3) Capitals before 1711 (Port-de-Paix, Petit-Goave, Leogane) and the 1749 move are not on the page. The Tortuga settlement dated 1625 is a buccaneer base, not the colony. The Treaty of Ryswick page itself was not opened; the page's own sentence is quoted.
(4) Counterparts: 'spanish-empire' for Spain on Hispaniola (there is no Spanish Santo Domingo dossier), 'kingdom-of-france' (eu-10), 'haiti' (am-08).
